stages.title: Web Core & Foundations
stages.subtitle: The foundational triad of the modern internet

topics.title: Internet Protocols & HTTP/3
topics.description: The internet is a global network connecting computers and devices for information sharing. Enables browsing, email, streaming, and communication through interconnected systems. Acts as worldwide infrastructure facilitating access to online resources and services.

resources.title: How Does the Internet Work? MDN Docs
How the Internet Works in 5 Minutes

topics.title: Semantic HTML5 & Accessibility (a11y)
topics.description: Website accessibility ensures sites are usable by everyone, including people with disabilities. Involves alt text for images, keyboard navigation, color contrast, and captions. Benefits all users, supports legal compliance, and expands audience reach.

topics.title: Modern CSS, Grid & Flexbox
topics.description: Modern CSS creates responsive designs using media queries, flexible typography, CSS-in-JS, and frameworks like Tailwind. Features CSS Logical Properties for internationalization and CSS Houdini for custom styling. Goals: performance, maintainability, and accessible designs across all devices.

topics.title: JavaScript (ES6+, DOM & Async)
topics.description: JavaScript is a versatile programming language that makes websites interactive. Runs in browsers, servers (Node.js), and desktop applications. Features dynamic typing, event-driven programming, and constant evolution. Essential for modern web development across frontend and backend.

topics.title: Git & GitHub Collaboration
topics.description: Git is a distributed version control system tracking code changes and enabling collaborative development. Features branching, merging, and complete project history. Allows offline work with local repositories. Fast, flexible, and the most popular VCS for software projects.

resources.title: Git & GitHub Crash Course For Beginners

stages.title: TypeScript & React UI Architecture
stages.subtitle: Enterprise-grade component design and type safety

topics.title: TypeScript Fundamentals & Generics
topics.description: Comprehensive technical guide and engineering practices for mastering TypeScript Fundamentals & Generics. Explore the curated video tutorials, official documentation, and deep-dive references below to build production competency.

topics.title: React Core, Hooks & Virtual DOM
topics.description: React Native enables building native mobile apps for iOS and Android using JavaScript and React. Compiles to native components for authentic look and performance. Features code sharing, hot reloading, and device API access. Ideal for React developers transitioning to mobile development.

topics.title: State Management (Zustand & Redux)
topics.description: Comprehensive technical guide and engineering practices for mastering State Management (Zustand & Redux). Explore the curated video tutorials, official documentation, and deep-dive references below to build production competency.

topics.title: Utility CSS & Tailwind CSS
topics.description: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework providing small, composable classes for rapid custom design development. Features mobile-first approach, automatic unused style removal (purging), and flexible customization. Enables quick responsive design prototyping without writing custom CSS.

resources.title: Tailwind CSS Full Course for Beginners

topics.title: Client Routing & Navigation
topics.description: React Router enables client-side routing in React applications, creating single-page apps with multiple views. Handles URL management, provides route definition components, and supports lazy loading and route guards. The standard navigation solution for React applications.

resources.title: A Complete Guide to Routing in React

stages.title: Build Systems & APIs
stages.subtitle: Modern bundling, network protocols and client caching

topics.title: Build Tooling (Vite, Rollup & Turbopack)
topics.description: Vite is a modern build tool using native ES modules for instant server starts and fast Hot Module Replacement. Supports Vue, React, Svelte with Rollup for production builds. Features CSS pre-processors and TypeScript integration. Enhances developer experience with faster development cycles.

resources.title: Vite - The Build Tool for the Web

topics.title: API Integration (REST, TanStack Query & GraphQL)
topics.description: Web APIs are interfaces provided by web browsers that allow JavaScript code to interact with the browser environment and the wider web. These APIs provide access to functionalities like manipulating the Document Object Model (DOM), handling user input, making network requests, managing browser history, and accessing device hardware like the camera or microphone. They essentially bridge the gap between JavaScript and the capabilities of the browser and the underlying operating system.

topics.title: Testing (Vitest, Jest & Playwright)
topics.description: Testing verifies software functionality and quality through unit, integration, functional, UI/UX, performance, security, accessibility, and compatibility testing. Modern approaches use automated tools, CI/CD pipelines, TDD, and BDD methodologies. Early bug detection improves application reliability.

resources.title: The Different Types of Software Tests
How to Test Web Applications - dotJS 2024

topics.title: Progressive Web Apps & Service Workers
topics.description: Progressive Web Apps (PWAs) are web applications behaving like native apps using HTML, CSS, JavaScript. Feature offline functionality, push notifications, home screen installation, and service workers for caching. Cross-platform, discoverable, and cost-effective alternative to native apps.

stages.title: Performance & Fullstack Web
stages.subtitle: Server rendering, streaming and Core Web Vitals

topics.title: Next.js & React Server Components (RSC)
topics.description: Next.js is a React framework supporting server-side rendering and static site generation. Features automatic code splitting, file-based routing, CSS support, API routes, and optimized performance. Includes live updates, smart preloading, and easy deployment. Ideal for SEO-friendly applications.

resources.title: Next.js for Beginners - Full Course at freeCodeCamp YouTube Channel

topics.title: Core Web Vitals & Web Performance
topics.description: Performance, in the context of web development, refers to how quickly and efficiently a website or web application loads and responds to user interactions. It encompasses various aspects like loading times, rendering speed, and overall responsiveness. Optimizing performance ensures a smooth and enjoyable user experience, leading to increased engagement and satisfaction.

resources.title: 9 Essential Strategies for Web Performance Optimization
The ultimate guide to web performance
Frontend System Design: The 2025 Web Performance Roadmap

topics.title: Frontend Security (CORS, CSP & JWT)
topics.description: CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) controls web page access to resources from different domains through HTTP headers. Servers specify allowed origins while browsers send preflight requests for permission. Prevents unauthorized access while enabling legitimate cross-origin requests for modern multi-domain applications.

topics.title: Edge Deployment & CDN Caching
topics.description: Cloudflare is a service that sits between your website and its visitors, acting as a reverse proxy. It provides a range of features including a content delivery network (CDN) to speed up website loading times by caching content closer to users, DDoS protection to safeguard against malicious attacks, and SSL/TLS encryption to secure data transmission. It essentially helps improve website performance, security, and reliability.

resources.title: Learn Cloudflare Workers 101 - Full Course for Beginners

stages.subtitle: Streaming LLMs, generative UI and intelligent applications

topics.title: Vercel AI SDK & Model Interfaces
topics.description: AI-assisted coding involves using artificial intelligence tools to help developers write code more efficiently and effectively. These tools can provide real-time suggestions, automate repetitive tasks, identify potential errors, and even generate code snippets based on natural language descriptions, ultimately speeding up development and improving code quality.

topics.title: Server-Sent Events & Streaming UIs
topics.description: WebSockets enable full-duplex, real-time communication over a single persistent connection between client and server. Unlike HTTP's request-response cycles, allows continuous bidirectional data exchange. Ideal for live chat, gaming, and real-time updates with low-latency communication.

topics.title: Client-Side Semantic Search & Embeddings
topics.description: Elasticsearch is a document-oriented search engine and database supporting INSERT, DELETE, RETRIEVE operations and analytics. Unlike general databases, it's optimized for search with powerful features for fast data retrieval based on search criteria.

topics.title: Real-time Collaboration & WebSockets
topics.description: WebSockets enable full-duplex, real-time communication over a single persistent connection between client and server. Unlike HTTP's request-response cycles, allows continuous bidirectional data exchange. Ideal for live chat, gaming, and real-time updates with low-latency communication.
